Compacts the data of a collection in order to reclaim disk space.
 The operation compacts the document and index data by rewriting the data while keeping the relevant entries.
Under normal circumstances running a compact operation is not necessary, as the collection data eventually gets compacted anyway. However, in some situations, e.g. after running many update or remove operations, the data for a collection may contain a lot of outdated data for which the space shall be reclaimed. In this case, the compaction operation can be used.
